verdict.label: Steady market
verdict.headline: Card prices are steady: no strong move either way right now.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 116.2 (+2.5% in a day) and momentum is 47: prices are steady. 84s cost 1,000, 85s 2,800 and 86s 5,500. Champions weekend starts Friday, when demand for meta cards usually peaks.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-10-29T03:24:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Buy cards you want for Champions before Friday evening
moves.detail: Demand for meta cards usually peaks when Champions weekend starts, so buying the cards you will play earlier is usually cheaper.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 1,000 (1.20 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,800 (1.33 coins per Item Score point), 86s 5,500 (1.34 coins per Item Score point), 87s 7,500 (1.36 coins per Item Score point), 88s 12,500 (1.51 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 85s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Corentin Tolisso and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Corentin Tolisso 86 Ultimate Scream -63.9%; Barnabás Varga 77 Rare -34.5%; Gastón Álvarez 75 Rare -28.0%; Louisa Necib 87 Base Hero -24.4%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.

moves.title: Bundesliga POTM September SBC ends soon
moves.detail: It costs about 946.9K coins to complete. Compare that with what you get before you build.
